title: The Brave Little Rabbit
summary: Max the rabbit learns that courage means doing something even when you are scared.

title: The Clever Fox and the Magic Apple
titleZh: 聪明的狐狸和魔法苹果
summary: A clever fox discovers that sharing makes the magic apple even more powerful.

title: The Secret Garden of Friendship
summary: Lily and Mia learn that true friendship grows when we share our secrets and help each other grow.

title: The Boy Who Told the Truth
summary: Tom learns that telling the truth takes real courage, and honesty is the most treasure-worthy thing of all.

title: The Little Star Who Never Gave Up
summary: Little Star Twinkle learns that perseverance and believing in yourself can help you achieve any dream.

title: The Kind Little Fox
summary: Felix the fox befriends Holly the hedgehog, showing that kindness makes the world a better place.

title: The Curious Little Owl
summary: Oliver the owl discovers a magical crystal cave behind a waterfall, learning that curiosity is the greatest gift of all.

title: The Little Penguin Who Made a Mistake
summary: Pip the penguin accidentally breaks Mrs. Bear's window and learns that being honest takes real courage.

title: The Little Elephant Who Dreamed in Colors
summary: Ellie the elephant discovers that imagination is her unique talent and learns that everyone has something special inside them.

title: The Little Squirrel's Big Feast
summary: Sam the squirrel hoards acorns all summer but feels lonely, until he learns that sharing brings friends — and joy far greater than anything he could keep for himself.

title: The Little Bear Who Listened with His Heart
summary: Bruno the bear learns that the best way to help a friend isn't to fix their problem — it's to truly listen and show empathy.

title: The Kitten Who Found a Friend
summary: Coco the kitten moves to a new neighborhood and meets Pip the bunny, who loves to paint but is too shy to share. Together they learn that true friendship means seeing the special light in someone and helping it shine brighter.

title: The Little Mouse Who Planted Kindness
summary: Milo the mouse spreads kindness through small acts — watering flowers, finding lost glasses, leaving berries for a shy hedgehog. When a storm destroys his home, all the friends he helped come together to build him a new one, teaching him that kindness always grows and returns.

title: The Little Duckling Who Found Her Courage
summary: Daisy the duckling has a squeaky quack that makes everyone laugh. With help from Freddy the Frog, she learns that being brave doesn't mean being perfect — it means letting the world hear your voice, whatever it sounds like.

title: The Puppy Who Always Asked Why
summary: Pippin the puppy asks 'why' about everything — until his endless questions help him solve a mystery and discover that curiosity is a superpower.

title: The Little Lamb Who Told a Little Lie
titleZh: 说了一个小谎的小羊羔
summary: Lily the lamb accidentally breaks a sunflower pot and blames the wind — but the lie grows heavy in her heart. Can she find the courage to tell the truth?

title: The Little Turtle Who Never Stopped Trying
summary: Toby the turtle dreams of winning the Forest Race, but everyone says turtles are too slow. With perseverance and practice, he learns that finishing the race is its own victory.

title: The Little Cat Who Made a Mouse Friend
titleZh: 交到老鼠朋友的小猫咪
summary: Milo the kitten moves to a new town and meets Maple the mouse. Despite everyone saying cats and mice can't be friends, they discover that true friendship doesn't care about rules — it cares about how you make each other feel.

title: The Little Hedgehog Who Planted Smiles
summary: Hattie the hedgehog finds joy in small acts of kindness — sharing strawberries, helping a tangled bird, cheering up a sad friend. When she returns home, she discovers that kindness has a way of growing and coming back in the most beautiful ways.

title: The Little Raccoon Who Learned to Share
summary: Ruby the raccoon finds a magical rainbow pebble but keeps it hidden away. With help from Ollie the Owl, she learns that true treasure isn't something you hold tight — it's something you share.

title: The Little Squirrel Who Found Thankfulness
titleZh: 找到感恩之心的小松鼠
summary: Sunny the squirrel never says thank you — until a big storm takes everything away. With help from her friends, she discovers that gratitude is the secret ingredient that turns what we have into enough.

title: The Little Firefly Who Found Her Light
summary: Flora the firefly is afraid to let her light shine because it is smaller than everyone else's. But when Max the mouse gets lost in the dark forest, Flora discovers that even the smallest light can guide someone home.

title: The Little Deer Who Walked in Someone Else's Shoes
summary: Dottie the deer is the fastest in the meadow — but she's never patient with Penny the snail. When Dottie sprains her leg and must walk slowly, she discovers how it feels to be left behind. With Penny by her side, she learns that the world is full of wonders when you slow down — and that real empathy means walking in someone else's shoes.

title: The Little Otter Who Found His Friend Again
titleZh: 重新找回朋友的小水獭
summary: Otto the otter and Cara the crane are the best of friends — until one silly quarrel makes Otto say something mean and Cara fly away. At first Otto tells himself he doesn't care. But playing alone isn't any fun at all. Can he swallow his pride, say sorry, and find his friend again?

title: The Little Chipmunk Who Kept a Secret
summary: Chip the chipmunk can't resist the shiny golden acorn on Grandpa Badger's windowsill — so he takes it home and hides it under his pillow. But as the whole meadow searches and Grandpa Badger's eyes grow sad, the 'lucky' acorn feels heavier and heavier. Can Chip find the courage to tell the truth and give it back?

title: The Little Bee Who Never Gave Up
summary: Buzzy the little bee dreams of collecting pollen like the big bees — but she is the clumsiest bee in the hive. She bumps into flowers, tangles in spiderwebs, and tumbles into puddles. When her sister laughs and her wings feel too small, Buzzy almost gives up. But with a little encouragement, she tries one more time... and one more time. When a storm threatens the hive, all her practice carries her farther than any bee ever flew.

title: The Little Hermit Crab Who Shared His Shell
titleZh: 把壳借出去的小寄居蟹
summary: Kai the little hermit crab loves his shiny pink shell more than anything in the sea. So when a homeless sea anemone, a shrimp with a broken shell, and a hurt blue crab all need help, Kai has a big problem — helping them means sharing his precious shell. But when a giant wave sweeps Kai away, the friends he was kind to all come rushing to save him. Kai learns that kindness is like the tide: everything you give out always comes back to you.

title: The Little Mole Who Met the Moon
summary: Mo the little mole has lived his whole life underground and never seen the moon. One night the wind opens a tiny hole in the earth — and silver light pours in. Mo digs his way up into a magical night garden, makes a new friend, and discovers a whole sparkling world. But when he wanders too far and gets lost, he learns that no adventure is complete without finding the way back home.

title: The Little Beaver Who Shared His River
summary: Bramble the beaver builds the biggest, finest dam in the whole forest — and the pond behind it is beautiful. 'Mine!' he says, and chases every thirsty friend away. But a pond with no friends in it is a very quiet place. When a storm breaks his dam, Bramble learns who really shows up in the rain — and discovers that sharing does not make your home smaller. It makes your whole world bigger.
